title: Synergistic effects of diammonium glycyrrhizinate and vitamin D3 against EMT in pulmonary fibrosis through modulating the crosstalk of STAT3/HSP90AA1 and HIF-1alpha pathway.
authors: Shen, Ying; Li, Xiaolan; Wei, Danyi; Guo, Hongwei; Yang, Xin; Zhu, Hongyan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甘草酸二铵与维生素D3抗肺纤维化EMT的协同机制，虽用分子对接和MD模拟分析STAT3/HSP90AA1与HIF-1通路，但核心是药物药理而非TF-DNA互作，蛋白-DNA结合仅间接涉及，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Diammonium glycyrrhizinate (DG), a triterpene saponin compound, derived from the traditional Chinese herb Licorice (Glycyrrhiza spp.). This component has been clinically applied for treating hepatitis and liver fibrosis. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to investigate the synergistic anti-pulmonary fibrosis (PF) effect and mechanism of DG and vitamin D3 (VD3). MATERIALS AND METHODS: The network pharmacology, molecular docking and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations were used to rapidly screen out potential synergetic targets and pathways of anti-PF. The studies on anti-PF effect and potential mechanism including lung weight, hydroxyproline content, pathological section staining, CCK-8, cell morphology, migration and invasion experiments were comprehensively evaluated. Furthermore, the epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) related markers, key targets and signaling pathways proteins were analyzed by immunohistochemical staining (IHC) and Western blot (WB). RESULTS: Network pharmacology analysis revealed that STAT3 and HSP90AA1 were the two key synergetic targets, and HIF-1 signaling pathway was the top-ranked in KEGG analysis. Actually, DG and VD3 significantly alleviated the symptoms of the bleomycin-induced PF model mice. Moreover, the expression of N-Cadherin and alpha-SMA were markedly decreased and E-Cadherin were upregulated both in vivo and vitro, suggesting the reduced EMT. Importantly, the combined use of DG and VD3 dramatically decreased the levels of STAT3, HSP90AA1, and HIF-1alpha in vitro, which were consistent with the prediction of network pharmacology and the verification of molecular docking and MD simulations. Additionally, silencing either STAT3 or HSP90AA1 mutually suppressed each other, thus significantly affecting the HIF-1alpha signaling pathway and EMT. CONCLUSION: In this study, the combination of DG and VD3 effectively ameliorated the pathological changes of PF and EMT effects by regulating the crosstalk between STAT3 and HSP90AA1 and the HIF-1alpha signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：甘草酸二铵（DG）是一种三萜皂苷类化合物，源自传统中草药甘草（Glycyrrhiza spp.）。该成分已在临床上用于治疗肝炎和肝纤维化。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨DG和维生素D3（VD3）协同抗肺纤维化（PF）的作用及其机制。材料与方法：采用网络药理学、分子对接和分子动力学（MD）模拟，快速筛选抗PF的潜在协同靶点和通路。通过肺重、羟脯氨酸含量、病理切片染色、CCK-8、细胞形态、迁移和侵袭实验，综合评价抗PF效果及潜在机制。此外，通过免疫组织化学染色（IHC）和蛋白质印迹（WB）分析上皮-间质转化（EMT）相关标志物、关键靶点和信号通路蛋白。结果：网络药理学分析显示，STAT3和HSP90AA1是两个关键的协同靶点，HIF-1信号通路在KEGG分析中排名最高。实际上，DG和VD3显著缓解了博来霉素诱导的PF模型小鼠的症状。此外，在体内和体外，N-钙黏蛋白和α-SMA的表达显著降低，而E-钙黏蛋白上调，表明EMT减少。重要的是，DG和VD3联合使用在体外显著降低了STAT3、HSP90AA1和HIF-1α的水平，这与网络药理学的预测以及分子对接和MD模拟的验证一致。此外，沉默STAT3或HSP90AA1相互抑制彼此，从而显著影响HIF-1α信号通路和EMT。结论：在本研究中，DG和VD3联合使用通过调节STAT3和HSP90AA1之间的串扰及HIF-1α信号通路，有效改善了PF的病理变化和EMT效应。
